translation:
Here begins the holy Bidu ||9||

1. Let us praise King Parabrahma; Gopal dwells in the lotus of the heart. Let us not set the Name aside for even an instant -- let time be spent in just this way.

2. Let us resort to the company of saints as to the Ganga; the thousand names are our gopichandan (sacred clay mark) and tulsi. Let us bathe daily in that Triveni confluence -- let us resort to the company of saints as to the Ganga.

3. Where there is no "I" and no "mine" -- that is the city of liberation, that alone is the true Kashi. Those who abide in this inner state are freed from the sorrow of dwelling in the womb. (refrain: Let us resort to the company of saints...)

4. The night of imagining is hard to bear; in the sleep of maya an age has been slept away. Joy and grief are both but dreams -- so wakes the discernment of true knowledge. (refrain)

5. For those whom Shri Padmanabh has awakened, the night has passed into dawn. They have left off both sleep and dream -- thus has the sun of Parabrahma risen. (refrain)

6. The sun that is Parabrahma burns forever; there night never comes even once. Day and night your remembrance goes on -- thus the darkness of delusion has passed away. (refrain)

7. Brahma and the rest, Shiva the primordial, Indra and the others, the sun and the moon -- all of them ever tremble at the fear of death; your saints alone are fearless. (refrain)

8. Thus has Shri Padmanabh spoken: this alone is the discernment of true knowledge. He taught the thousand names; the mantra of Hari is the essence of all. (refrain)

Here the holy Bidu is complete ||9||
